field.name: SPC
field.description: option byte security protection code. 0xAA: no security protection 0xCC: security protection level high any value except 0xAA or 0xCC : security protection level low.

field.name: DATA[15:0]
field.brief: Store DATA of option bytes block after system reset
field.description: Store DATA of option bytes block after system reset.

field.name: NWLD_CLK
field.brief: Select the clock for loading no waiting time area
field.description: NWLD_CLK 00: 200M PLL CLK 01: 160M PLL CLK 10: 120M PLL CLK 11: 8M HSI CLK

field.name: ECC_EN
field.description: ECC_EN 0: SRAM ECC disable 1: SRAM ECC enable

field.name: SRAM_RST
field.description: SRAM_RST 0: Initialize SRAM after power reset 1: Do not initialize SRAM after power reset

field.name: nRST_STDBY
field.brief: Generate a reset instead of entering standby mode
field.description: nRST_STDBY 0: generator a reset instead of entering standby mode 1: no reset when entering standby mode

field.name: nRST_DPSLP
field.brief: Generate a reset instead of entering Deep-sleep mode
field.description: nRST_DPSLP 0: generator a reset instead of entering Deep-sleep mode 1: no reset when entering Deep-sleep mode

field.name: nWDG_HW
field.description: nWDG_HW 0: hardware free watchdog 1: software free watchdog
